newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa to sign 70 mln rand aid deal with Italy.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa to sign 70 mln rand aid deal with Italy.

text.p: South Africa is to sign a deal with Italy that will reap 70 million rand of development aid grants during 1996-97, the South African Department of Foreign Affairs said on Wednesday.

Following bilateral talks, deputy minister of foreign affairs Aziz Pahad and his Italian opposite number Rino Serri will sign a joint declaration of intent on development in Cape Town on September 19.
This commits the two governments to sign a Memorandum of Understanding on Development Cooperation before the end of the year, the terms of which will include the aid package.
The grants will mainly be used to fund projects in the health and education sectors and for the promotion of small to medium business enterprises.
